dct_title_s: Satellite detected mudflow as of 11 October 2026 in Gorkha District, Gandaki Province, Nepal
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: FL20261011NPL** This map illustrates the cumulative satellite-detected water extent derived from Sentinel-2 imagery acquired on 11 October 2026. Within the analysed area of about 470 km², approximately 18 km² of land appear to be affected by flood waters and/or mudflow. The analysis indicates that about 400 buildings were exposed to the mudflow and approximately 33 km of road were affected. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send any ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre.
